name: Helix Carousel
hint: Drag sideways, flick, click a card, or focus the coil and use the arrow keys.
description: Cards wound around a 3D helix. Dragging rotates the spiral with velocity-aware spring snapping; cards ride a helical thread, sinking into fog, blur and shadow with distance and turning their backs on the far side of the coil.
usage: Use for collections where browsing is the point: portfolios, drops, album/art galleries, feature tours. 6–14 items. Avoid for content that must be compared side by side. Pass `items` (array of { id, title, caption?, image?, node?, palette?, variant? }; a card shows `node`, else `image`, else procedural art from `palette`/`variant` or `art`, else a plain surface) and `cards={items.length}` (cards is capped at items.length so no item is on the coil twice; the default 9 also caps it). `label` names the region for screen readers. The front card is `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(index, item)`; `onSelect(item, index, event)` fires when the front card is clicked or Enter/Space is pressed on the coil (open a detail view from it). Keyboard: focus the coil, Left/Right turn one card, Home/End jump to the ends; the front card is announced politely once the coil settles. autoSpin pauses off screen, in a hidden tab, on hover, keyboard focus and drag, and shows a pause/play button. disabled makes it inert (no keys, drag, clicks, buttons or auto-spin), dims and desaturates the coil, and sets aria-disabled. Under prefers-reduced-motion card changes are an instant step with a short fade. Give it width, not height: it sizes its own height, and if the coil would spill past the sides of its box it is scaled down to fit. With no items it shows `emptyLabel`. `demo` winds the sample art collection (gallery only).

dataProps.type: Array<{ id, title, caption?, image?, alt?, node?, art?, palette?, variant? }>
dataProps.description: The cards, in order. id keeps each card stable; title and caption show under the coil and are announced; image (URL) or node (ReactNode) is the card face, else procedural art from palette/variant (or an art id in art), else a plain surface.
Controlled front card (index into items). Changing it turns the coil there; a turn you do not accept springs back once the coil rests.
Front card at mount when uncontrolled.

(index, item) => void, each time a turn by the user (drag, keys, buttons, a click on a card) or auto-spin brings a new card to the front. Not called for the entrance or for turns made to follow `value`.
(item, index, event) => void, when the front card is chosen: clicked, or Enter/Space pressed on the focused coil. Use it to open the piece.
Accessible name of the carousel region.
Shown when there are no items. Empty string shows nothing.

dataProps.type: { previous?, next?, pause?, play?, hint?, choose?, unavailable? }
dataProps.description: Screen-reader text for the buttons and the coil's key hint, for translation. Defaults: "Previous card", "Next card", "Pause rotation", "Start rotation", the arrow-key hint, "Enter chooses the front card.", "Unavailable."
Inert: no keys, drag, clicks, buttons or auto-spin; dimmed and aria-disabled.
With no items, wind the sample art collection and name the region "Art collection". Gallery only; leave off in real UI.
The root <section>, for measuring or scrolling to the carousel. className, style and other props (data-*, aria-*) land on it too.
